name: portal-remote-trigger
notes: Stay in the Nether: an item thrown into the return portal R_N (17+ blocks from the drill exit) comes out of its overworld twin R_O, lands on a wooden pressure plate, and the plate's redstone line fires a dropper of cobblestone into the drill portal D_O: a fresh item (no portal cooldown) that goes to the Nether and makes the game generate the next portal on the field. The overworld side has NO player and no forced chunk near it: the only thing loading it is the portal ticket the arriving item places around R_O (3x3 chunks entity-ticking for 300 ticks), which covers the plate, the line, the dropper and D_O. Overworld (x shifted 1600 from spawn): D_O interior x 1608..1609 y 59..61 z 0; R_O interior x 1621..1622; plates (1621, 59, 1..2) on hoppers; dust x 1609..1620 z 1; dropper (1608, 59, 1) facing north into D_O. Nether: field bedrock x 200..207 z -1..1 at y 58 (two lines: exit x 201), R_N interior x 218..219 (17 from the exit, so drill trips never link to it; its exit point 1748 is within 128 of R_O and 139 from D_O). Two trips, the generated portal's portal blocks removed between them (the player mines one frame block). Asserts: the overworld machine is unloaded before each throw; trip 1 converts x 200..203, trip 2 x 204..207.
